note: Year-round offers for BOC credit cards. The English YRO pages at /creditcard/promo/offer_yro/hk/eng/ and /creditcard/promo/offer_yro/mc/eng/ are Nuxt apps (js_shell); the listing body is these same-origin public JSON files, which the app loads from /creditcard/promo/offer_yro/hk/data/{Category}.json and /creditcard/promo/offer_yro/mc/data/macau/{Category}.json. Each file is a top-level array. The mc path is Macau merchant offers for the same Hong Kong-issued cards, not a mainland China catalogue. Filter to public=1. This run had 569 public items. There is no per-merchant terms URL in the JSON; terms sit on the YRO page and shared T and C links.
